ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated at the distal tips and lower central margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white mottling and focal clusters located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes and sparse speckling across the medial surface of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch depth is moderate, roughly 12% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of peaks varies between 3-8 pixels, with the most pronounced irregularities observed on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe displays a pronounced convex upward sweep terminating in a sharp distal tip; left lobe displays a flatter, more horizontal trajectory with a distinct mid-edge indentation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of circular high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle scars) localized at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe and along the upper margin of the left lobe's distal region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin, white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed running diagonally across the central dark region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, large semi-circular tissue deficit (indentation/notch) is visible on the upper margin of the left fluke lobe, approximately one-third of the way from the median notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized white speckling and 'splash' patterns at the base of the fluke where it meets the water line, separate from the primary pigmentation mapping.
